data.narrative:
Cohesive Robotics, led by founder David Pietrocola, is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $5M+. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 peers—1 public (277810.KQ) and 8 private companies including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI—though only 1 same-stage comparable was identified within the Robotics & Manufacturing space.

A Stage-Progression methodology was applied, using the $5M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement. This method yielded an implied valuation of $12M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-filter comparables; while 10 same-sector peers exist, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters produced 3+ datapoints necessary for reliable median calibration.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects the stage-typical progression logic but carries material uncertainty given the absence of tight peer validation. Key risks to valuation include the thin comparable set in this subsector, execution risk at Seed stage, and potential divergence of Cohesive's go-to-market or technology from peer benchmarks. Additional funding rounds, technical milestones, or market traction would provide stronger data for future valuation refinement.
